1803:14920.name: Parts/Input OTP/OTP Cell
1803:14920.description:
Internal sub-component of Input OTP. Not intended for direct use.

Represents a single digit cell within the OTP input row. Contains a single text node ("Digit") that displays the entered character. State (empty, filled, active, error) is managed by the parent Input OTP component via its variable collection.
